commands.name: m114_near_boundary_matched_history_outcome_surface

decision_rule: Before training another objective, build an outcome-critical matched-history surface where normal history is near the safety boundary and reset or wrong history measurably reduces clearance or success.
failure_criteria: candidate pairs are matched in current response but all continuations remain far from the obstacle boundary
normal history does not outperform reset or wrong history on clearance, collision, success, or mitigation
the surface depends on hidden parameters or oracle feasibility labels as actor inputs
the selected corpus is only hard but not matched-current-response
hypothesis: M113 failed because M111 pairs are feature-ambiguous but not outcome-critical. A near-boundary matched surface should make history sensitivity matter for clearance and collision outcomes.
success_criteria: matched-current-response candidates are filtered or relocated to low normal clearance margins
normal/reset/delayed/zero-action/wrong-history continuations are compared on outcome metrics
accepted rows require normal-history margin or success advantage
the result decides whether to train an outcome-weighted intervention objective
